heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The JWT MUST NOT use "none" as the signing algorithm.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The JWT MUST use the sub (subject) claim for the LWS subject identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The JWT MUST use the iss (issuer) claim for the LWS issuer identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The JWT MUST use the client_id (client ID) claim for the LWS client identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The claims sub, iss, and client_id MUST all use the same URI value.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: Any audience restriction in the ID Token MUST use the aud (audience) claim. The aud claim MUST include the target authorization server.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The JWT MUST include an exp (expiration) claim, indicating the time the token expires.

heading: Authentication Credential Serialization
text: The JWT MUST include an iat (issued at) claim, indicating the time the token was issued.

heading: Authentication Credential Validation
text: In the absence of a pre-existing trust relationship, the verifier MUST dereference the sub (subject) claim in the authentication credential. The resulting resource MUST be formatted as a valid controlled identifier document [[!CID-1.0]] with an id value equal to the subject identifier.

heading: Authentication Credential Validation
text: A verifier MUST reject any tokens using an alg header parameter that equals "none".

heading: Authentication Credential Validation
text: A verifier MUST validate all claims described by the authentication credential data model.

heading: Authentication Credential Validation
text: The verifier MUST use the kid (key id) value from the signed JWT header to identify a verification method from the subject's controlled identifier document. This process is described in [[!CID-1.0]] Section 3.3. Using the selected verification method from the controlled identifier document, the signature of the JWT MUST be validated as described in [[!RFC7515]], Section 5.2.

heading: Authentication Credential Validation
text: A verifier MUST ensure that the current time is before the time represented by the exp claim. Implementers MAY provide for some small leeway to account for clock skew.

heading: Token Type Identifier
text: A self-issued JSON Web Token used as an authentication credential MUST use the urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt URI when interacting with an authorization server.
